scope.condition: mask reused across frames or after call

trigger: Alternating residual text or unexpected change to a protected region after gradient compositing
action: Pass mask.copy() or construct independent per-call masks; compare mask before and after, then inspect contiguous encoded frames. Newly constructed disposable masks are not automatically faulty.

synthetic_probe.boundary: Synthetic mask mutation probe; no claim about real video repair quality
synthetic_probe.reproduction: mask=np.zeros((64,64),np.uint8); mask[10:54,10:54]=255; before=mask.copy(); src=np.full((64,64,3),180,np.uint8); dst=np.full((64,64,3),90,np.uint8); cv2.seamlessClone(src,dst,mask,(32,32),cv2.NORMAL_CLONE); np.count_nonzero(mask!=before)

limits: Observed in installed OpenCV 5.0.0; do not assert every version mutates the mask.
This establishes buffer mutation and copy isolation, not full-video visual acceptance.
1-1 and 4-2 video-quality claims remain in their own source-bound reviews.
